# Pipeline Catalog (Quick Reference)

38 pipelines. `ready` runs out of the box; `needs weights` requires `checkpoint=` (your trained model). Removed pipelines are listed on [this page](../pipelines/removed.md).

| Pipeline | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `active_fire` | ready | Days with a MODIS active-fire detection per 1 km pixel for a month or date range, with fire points |
| `archaeological_site` | ready | Local Relief Model and multi-directional hillshade from a DEM, for expert interpretation |
| `biodiversity_hotspot` | ready | Local Shannon habitat-diversity map from WorldCover 2021, with top-decile hotspots |
| `building_footprints` | ready | Building footprints from Microsoft, Google or OpenStreetMap data (or segmentation with your own trained model) |
| `change_detection` | ready | Change vector analysis between two dates (Otsu threshold); or your own siamese model |
| `coastal_monitoring` | ready | Land/water change between two dates from MNDWI (shoreline retreat and advance) |
| `crop_health` | ready | NDVI drop between two dates (vegetation stress / loss anomaly) |
| `crop_monitoring` | needs weights | Crop-type segmentation with your trained model (checkpoint required) |
| `deforestation` | needs weights | Forest-loss classes between two dates with your trained model (checkpoint required) |
| `disaster_assessment` | needs weights | Pre/post-event damage classes with your trained siamese model (checkpoint required) |
| `drainage_analysis` | ready | Flow accumulation, stream network with Strahler order, and Height Above Nearest Drainage (HAND) from a DEM |
| `evapotranspiration` | ready | Annual evapotranspiration, potential ET and their ratio for a year from MODIS MOD16A3GF (500 m) |
| `flood_mapping` | ready | Flooded area = MNDWI water on the flood date minus permanent water from a dry reference |
| `forest_change` | ready | Forest loss and gain between two years (2015-2020) from the JAXA PALSAR forest/non-forest map |
| `glacier_monitoring` | ready | Snow/ice area change between two dates from NDSI, on commonly cloud-free pixels |
| `land_cover` | ready | ESA WorldCover 2021 reference map (or Dynamic World / your own model) for a bounding box |
| `land_surface_temperature` | ready | Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 land surface temperature in deg C |
| `landcover_change` | ready | Where annual 10 m land cover changed between two years (2017-2023), and from/to which class |
| `landslide_detection` | needs weights | Landslide scars from a before/after pair with your trained change model (checkpoint required) |
| `road_extraction` | needs weights | Road segmentation with your trained model (checkpoint required) |
| `road_network` | ready | Road network from OpenStreetMap: length by road class, road density and a GeoPackage of every road |
| `snow_cover` | ready | Snow/ice extent from NDSI > 0.4 on one date |
| `solar_detection` | needs weights | Solar-panel segmentation with your trained model (checkpoint required) |
| `solar_potential` | ready | Clear-sky relative irradiance (0-1) on terrain for a date and hour, from a DEM |
| `surface_water_dynamics` | ready | Permanent, seasonal, new and lost surface water 1984-2020 from the JRC Global Surface Water history |
| `terrain_analysis` | ready | Elevation, slope, aspect, hillshade and ruggedness (TRI) from the Copernicus 30 m DEM |
| `urban_expansion` | ready | New and lost built-up area between two years from the annual 10 m land-cover product |
| `urban_growth` | needs weights | Urban expansion between two Landsat dates with your trained model (checkpoint required) |
| `urban_heat_island` | ready | Landsat land surface temperature and areas hotter than the scene mean + threshold |
| `vegetation_anomaly` | ready | NDVI anomaly, z-score and Vegetation Condition Index of a month against the same month in earlier years |
| `vegetation_indices` | ready | NDVI, EVI and NDWI per date across a time series |
| `volcano_monitoring` | ready | Landsat thermal anomalies (scene mean + 20 C by default); candidates, not confirmed activity |
| `water_bodies` | ready | Surface water mask from NDWI (green, NIR); or your own trained model |
| `water_extent_timeseries` | ready | Surface-water area for each of several dates and a map of how often each pixel was water (MNDWI) |
| `water_quality` | ready | Relative chlorophyll index (NDCI) and red-reflectance turbidity indicator inside water |
| `wetland_mapping` | ready | Open water vs inundated vegetation from MNDWI and EVI |
| `wildfire_severity` | ready | Burn severity from dNBR (USGS classes) between a pre-fire and a post-fire date |
| `wind_farm_siting` | ready | Slope and land-cover exclusion screen with a terrain-exposure score (no wind speed) |
